steps.content: Her fight has no end, as if she's stuck in a muddy swamp. Filth keeps emerging and blocking her way forward.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: My fight is not over yet... It'll never be over...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: No start, no end, just give me more enemies... I can handle it on my own...
She raises her right hand and clenches her fist to fight, but then she sees the vague red mark branded on her wrist.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Someone has resisted me... Someone... is still fighting?
